input.report: Both of my invoices were settled as payments. INV-001 (Acme Paper Co, V-100, USD 640, invoice A-7781) and INV-002 (Bluebird Courier, V-101, USD 275, invoice BB-2210) both met all criteria: vendors approved, accounts active, amounts within per-invoice caps (1500 and 800 respectively), and no duplicate claims or prior results existed in the shared cache. I filed claims for both, executed payments (PAY-0001 and PAY-0002), sent remittance advices to ap@acme.vendor.example and billing@bluebird.vendor.example, and recorded paid results in the cache. No invoices were declined.
